title: YouTube URL Regex Asymmetry
reproduction_steps: Submit YouTube embed URL (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/embed/...) via Dashboard URL form
root_cause: Frontend regex permits /embed/, /v/, and /live/ paths, whereas backend downloader regex only matches /watch?v= and /shorts/
recommended_fix: Harmonize backend regex in downloader.py to support canonical /embed/, /v/, and /live/ paths

title: Channel Profile Scoring Mode Schema Mismatch
reproduction_steps: Select 'heuristic' scoring mode in Monitored Channels settings modal and save
root_cause: Frontend renders <option value="heuristic">, but backend Pydantic ChannelProcessingProfile enforces Literal['ai'] resulting in HTTP 422
recommended_fix: Either add 'heuristic' to backend Literal union or remove the legacy heuristic option from frontend UI

title: Settings Integer Falsy Value Coercion
reproduction_steps: Enter '0' or '-1' in settings numeric field (e.g. default clip count)
root_cause: Expression 'parseInt(val) || 5' coerces valid 0 to default 5 and allows negative integers to escape to backend
recommended_fix: Update parsing logic to: const parsed = parseInt(val, 10); Math.max(1, isNaN(parsed) ? 5 : parsed)

title: Missing ARIA Dialog Role and Modal Flag
reproduction_steps: Inspect modal container elements in DOM with screen reader
root_cause: ProcessVideoModal and PodcastSelectionModal omit role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" attributes
recommended_fix: Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby attributes to root modal containers

title: Modal DOM Focus Trap Absence
reproduction_steps: Open modal and press Tab repeatedly to cycle through focusable elements
root_cause: Focus cycles out of modal container into background dashboard navigation controls
recommended_fix: Implement a focus trap hook or use a standard accessible modal primitive to contain Tab focus

title: ScoreRing Missing Progressbar Role and Semantics
reproduction_steps: Inspect clip AI score badge in Clips view with screen reader
root_cause: ScoreRing is an inline styled div without role="progressbar" or aria-valuenow/aria-valuemax
recommended_fix: Add role="status" or role="meter" with aria-valuenow and aria-label to ScoreRing badge

title: Dashboard URL Input Missing Dynamic aria-invalid
reproduction_steps: Submit an invalid YouTube URL string and inspect the input DOM element
root_cause: Input displays red visual border and text message but omits aria-invalid="true" attribute
recommended_fix: Bind aria-invalid={Boolean(urlError)} and aria-describedby="url-error-msg" to the URL input element

title: Alembic Migration Head Baseline Divergence
reproduction_steps: Run 'alembic current' against local PostgreSQL instance
root_cause: Database is at migration d4e5f6a7b8c9 while migration e6f7a8b9c0d1 exists in repository
recommended_fix: Execute 'alembic upgrade head' in authorized deployment environment to apply default private privacy migration

title: Missing FFmpeg Faststart Flag on MP4 Outputs
reproduction_steps: Inspect FFmpeg command arrays for final MP4 container encoding
root_cause: Some render command invocations omit '-movflags +faststart' causing moov atom to be written at EOF
recommended_fix: Standardize all MP4 output invocations to include '-movflags' '+faststart' for optimized web streaming

title: Synthetic Scene Cut Detection Sensitivity
reproduction_steps: Run verify_advanced_podcast_real_render.py on low-contrast synthetic clips
root_cause: Synthetic test frames with subtle color transitions yield scdet scores below default 17.5 threshold
recommended_fix: Document 17.5 as optimal for authentic high-contrast video cuts or add adaptive thresholding for subtle cuts
